name: Chang
verdict: Chang wordmark on Port FC's chest; Chang is Thai Beverage's flagship beer brand, and ThaiBev is an SGX-listed company controlled by the Sirivadhanabhakdi family. Nothing found.
aliases: เบียร์ช้าง
น้ำแร่ธรรมชาติ ตราช้าง
note: Port FC's 2026-27 sponsor ceremony names 'น้ำแร่ธรรมชาติ ตราช้าง' (Chang Natural Mineral Water) among the 19 sponsors, while the shirt's chest shows the red Chang (beer) wordmark with the elephants mark; both are ThaiBev Chang brands. No human-rights finding against Thai Beverage found.
